purpose: Attach the independently reproduced v126 camera-set perturbation contract to opened PoolFire fit trajectories, then measure the classical inverse-problem envelope before any neural-operator training.
claim_boundary: This is a coarse-grid public-CFD straight-ray proxy screen. It is not a learned algorithm, curved-ray result, wall-time or memory result, external generalization result, experimental BOST result, or paper success.

camera_set_contract.nested_subset_rule: A trajectory-specific deterministic permutation of the v126 bank is frozen; each camera count is a prefix, so adding cameras preserves all existing camera identities.
camera_set_contract.rig_temporal_rule: The true rig and reported calibration error are fixed across all selected frames of one trajectory and profile.
camera_set_contract.noise_temporal_rule: Observation noise is independent across frame and camera, keyed by trajectory, frame, profile and stable camera ID.
camera_set_contract.permutation_rule: Reordering the same camera roster must restore every observation and camera token exactly within numerical tolerance.
camera_set_contract.true_vs_reported_rule: Observations are generated by the true rig; every inverse control sees only the reported rig and noisy observation.

classical_controls.interpretation: This screen identifies classical headroom and failure regimes. It does not authorize neural training by itself.

decision_rule.pass_attachment: All 300 cells and 1500 classical rows independently reproduce, source roles stay fit-only, permutation and adjoint checks pass, and validation/test truth remains unread.
decision_rule.next_if_passed: Use the validated envelope to define a trajectory-level noise-and-camera-count training split and test the smallest set-conditioned warm initializer against all frozen controls.
decision_rule.next_if_failed: Fix only the identified data or physics mismatch; do not train a neural model on an invalid attachment.
